question: How many orders has each customer placed?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the total amount spent by each customer?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Which products cost more than 100?

question: What is the average price of products in each category?

question: Which customers have never placed an order?

    FROM orders
    WHERE orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
);

question: Which customers have placed more than one order?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1;
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1;

question: What is the total quantity sold for each product?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name;
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;

question: Which orders were placed after January 31, 2026?

question: What is the total revenue generated by each product category?

FROM products AS p

question: Which customers purchased Electronics products?
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Electronics';
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY c.name;
